name: FGVC-Aircraft
description: Fine-grained aircraft image dataset containing 10,200 images across 102 aircraft model variants, with annotations for variant, family, and manufacturer.
citation: Maji, S., Kannala, J., Rahtu, E., Blaschko, M., & Vedaldi, A. (2013). Fine-Grained Visual Classification of Aircraft. arXiv:1306.5151. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1306.5151
